metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Needles, California higher than Phoenix, Arizona on June 21, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily LST products for the exact date 2017-06-21 over two small buffered points: - Primary: Terra MOD11A1 (MODIS/006/MOD11A1) - Fallback: Aqua MYD11A1 (MODIS/006/MYD11A1) 2. Masking strategy: Mask using QC_Day bits (bits 0–1 <= 1) and LST > 0. Not about clouds specifically, but QC mask removes cloud/low-quality pixels. 3. Logic for valid vs null/error: - If image collections are empty for both Terra and Aqua → C1. - If collections exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0 → C2. - If mean is null/NaN or outside plausible range (-100C to 100C) → C3. - Otherwise compare Needles vs Phoenix and print A: Yes or B: No. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const dateStr = '2017-06-21'; const start = ee.Date(dateStr); const end = start.advance(1, 'day'); // Locations (approx city centers), buffered to 3 km for adequate pixels at 1 km scale const needlesPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-114.614, 34.848]); const phoenixPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.074, 33.448]); const needlesGeom = needlesPt.buffer(3000); const phoenixGeom = phoenixPt.buffer(3000); const scalePrimary = 1000; const scaleFallback = 3000; function maskMODISDay(img) { const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km'); const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const goodQA = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 0-1 <= 1 (best or good) const validLST = lst.gt(0); return img.updateMask(goodQA.and(validLST)); } async function statsForCollection(collectionId, geom, scale) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom); const size = await col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return {exists: false}; } const img = maskMODISDay(col.mosaic()); // Total 1 km pixels in geometry (approximate), independent of mask let totalCount = await ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one') .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true}) .get('one').getInfo(); if (!totalCount || totalCount === 0) { // retry with coarser scale totalCount = await ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one') .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scaleFallback, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true}) .get('one').getInfo(); } const validCount = await img.select('LST_Day_1km') .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true}) .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); const meanDN = await img.select('LST_Day_1km') .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true}) .get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); let meanC = null; if (meanDN !== null && meanDN !== undefined) { meanC = meanDN * 0.02 - 273.15; // scale to Kelvin, then to Celsius } const cloudPct = (totalCount && totalCount > 0 && validCount !== null) ? (100 * (1 - validCount / totalCount)) : null; return { exists: true, images: size, totalCount: totalCount || 0, validCount: validCount || 0, cloudPct: cloudPct, meanC: meanC }; } async function getCityLST(geom, cityName) { // Try Terra first let s = await statsForCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1', geom, scalePrimary); if (s.exists && s.validCount > 0 && s.meanC !== null) { return {...s, source: 'Terra MOD11A1'}; } // Fallback to Aqua if Terra invalid or 0 valid pixels let a = await statsForCollection('MODIS/006/MYD11A1', geom, scalePrimary); if (a.exists && a.validCount > 0 && a.meanC !== null) { return {...a, source: 'Aqua MYD11A1'}; } // Determine failure type const terraExists = s.exists; const aquaExists = a.exists; if (!terraExists && !aquaExists) { return {failure: 'C1'}; } if ((terraExists && (s.validCount === 0 || s.meanC === null)) && (aquaExists && (a.validCount === 0 || a.meanC === null))) { return {failure: 'C2'}; } return {failure: 'C3'}; } try { console.log(`Date: ${dateStr}`); const needlesRes = await getCityLST(needlesGeom, 'Needles, CA'); const phoenixRes = await getCityLST(phoenixGeom, 'Phoenix, AZ'); // Handle failures if (needlesRes.failure || phoenixRes.failure) { const failurePriority = (tag) => ({'C1':1,'C2':2,'C3':3}[tag]); const failures = []; if (needlesRes.failure) failures.push(needlesRes.failure); if (phoenixRes.failure) failures.push(phoenixRes.failure); const finalFail = failures.sort((a,b)=>failurePriority(a)-failurePriority(b))[0]; console.log(`Needles status: ${needlesRes.failure || 'OK'}`); console.log(`Phoenix status: ${phoenixRes.failure || 'OK'}`); if (finalFail === 'C1') { console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).'); } else if (finalFail === 'C2') { console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).'); } else { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None, NaN, or invalid).'); } return; } // Validate plausible temperature ranges function invalid(val) { return (val === null || isNaN(val) || val < -100 || val > 100); } if (invalid(needlesRes.meanC) || invalid(phoenixRes.meanC)) { console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None, NaN, or invalid).'); return; } const nCloud = (needlesRes.cloudPct !== null) ? needlesRes.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'; const pCloud = (phoenixRes.cloudPct !== null) ? phoenixRes.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'; console.log(`Needles Source: ${needlesRes.source} (images: ${needlesRes.images}), Valid px: ${needlesRes.validCount}/${needlesRes.totalCount} (cloud: ${nCloud}%), LST_C: ${needlesRes.meanC.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Phoenix Source: ${phoenixRes.source} (images: ${phoenixRes.images}), Valid px: ${phoenixRes.validCount}/${phoenixRes.totalCount} (cloud: ${pCloud}%), LST_C: ${phoenixRes.meanC.toFixed(2)}`); const answer = (needlesRes.meanC > phoenixRes.meanC) ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No'; console.log(answer); } catch (err) { console.error('Error:', err); console.log('D: Processing/Code Error'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
